name: P4-AR "SecondWind" Rifle
description: Behring's classic P4-AR rifle features a collapsible stock and shortened barrel, making it an ideal choice for close-quarter firefights. Its accuracy and general ease of use make it universally valued among security, military and civilian users. To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the weapon with a rich blue base adorned with a sleek, flowing air design along the length of the gun.
